title: BikeLab FIT Analyzer
description:
Browser-only analyzer for cycling .fit activity files: cadence stability, speed/cadence stability, climbing stability, Variability Index (NP/AP, 30-second rolling mean on the 1 s series, zeros included, pauses from FIT timer events) and power:heart-rate decoupling, each with a Monte Carlo uncertainty band.

Version 2.0.0 replaces the FIT reader of 1.0.0, which returned zero records for Garmin files. The new reader matches Garmin's decoder (@garmin/fitsdk 21.222.0) field by field on 47 public and 4 synthetic files (218,537 records, 0 differences) and fitdecode on 5 files the Garmin JavaScript SDK cannot read (9,627 records, 0 differences). VI thresholds come from the TrainingPeaks reference table; the other thresholds are unvalidated heuristics. Results are not comparable with 1.0.0.

FIT is a protocol of Garmin International; this software contains no Garmin code and is not affiliated with Garmin.
